bugClass.title: Serial CI stages exceed the job time limit
bugClass.cause: A single CI workflow job executes all check stages serially, so cumulative runtime approaches or exceeds its timeout; there is no parallel job split or headroom guard to keep execution within the limit.
bugClass.criteria: Match when a workflow defines one job that sequences multiple check stages and their combined runtime can consume the job timeout, without parallelizing stages or enforcing a runtime/headroom guard. Each condition is sufficient: serial accumulation toward the timeout, or lack of a guard against it. Exclude cases where the limit is exceeded by one independently slow stage rather than cumulative serial work.
